stories.headline: OpenAI Shuts Down Sora Video App, Redirecting Compute to Robotics and Enterprise

key_facts.fact: OpenAI announced on March 24 it is discontinuing Sora, including the consumer app, developer API, and video features in ChatGPT
key_facts.excerpt: Co-founder and Chief Executive Sam Altman revealed the decision today, telling staff in an email that the company will wind down all products

key_facts.fact: OpenAI is redirecting compute resources toward ChatGPT, a 'superapp' combining ChatGPT, Codex, and web browser, and long-term bets on autonomous robots
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI is redirecting resources toward higher-priority enterprise initiatives: Productivity tools for business customers, a new ChatGPT 'superapp' combining ChatGPT, Codex coding tool, and web browser, long-term bets on autonomous robots

key_facts.fact: Disney's planned multiyear character licensing agreement—covering Mickey Mouse, Pixar, Marvel, and Star Wars characters—has been cancelled
key_facts.excerpt: Just three months after announcing a three-year partnership with Disney, OpenAI is now discontinuing its Sora AI video platform

key_facts.fact: The Sora research team will continue focusing on world simulation research to advance robotics for real-world physical tasks
key_facts.excerpt: the Sora research team continues to focus on world simulation research to advance robotics that will help people solve real-world, physical tasks

key_facts.fact: Applications Chief Fidji Simo directed employees to avoid 'side quests' and concentrate on agentic systems enhancing productivity
key_facts.excerpt: Applications Chief Fidji Simo directed employees to avoid 'side quests' and concentrate on agentic systems enhancing productivity

key_facts.fact: Sora launched in February 2024, reached #1 on Apple App Store in October 2025, but declined in user interest; the shutdown comes ahead of OpenAI's expected IPO
key_facts.excerpt: The closure of the resource-intensive AI app comes ahead of an expected initial public stock offering from OpenAI in the coming months

stories.headline: OpenAI Raises Additional $10B, Bringing Record Fundraise Past $120B Ahead of IPO

key_facts.fact: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar announced the company is raising an additional $10 billion, bringing total fundraise to 'north of $120 billion'
key_facts.excerpt: The fresh capital brings OpenAI's record fundraise to 'north of $120 billion,' Friar said in an interview on 'Mad Money.'

key_facts.fact: New $10B tranche co-led by Andreessen Horowitz, D.E. Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG, and T. Rowe Price, with Microsoft also participating
key_facts.excerpt: Andreessen Horowitz, D.E. Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG and T. Rowe Price are participants in the new $10 billion commitment... Microsoft, a longtime investor in OpenAI and one of its major computing providers, is also joining this part of the funding round

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's February 2026 revenue matched its entire Q1 2025 revenue, and Codex—its largest agentic deployment—grew 5x since January
key_facts.excerpt: We did the same amount of revenue in Feb 2026, as we did in the entire Q1 of 2025. And Codex, as the largest agentic deployment to date, grew 5x since January.

key_facts.fact: Friar signaled IPO readiness, stating the round 'de-risks' the path to becoming a public company
key_facts.excerpt: OPENAI CFO FRIAR: WE HAVE TO BUILD A COMPANY THAT'S READY TO BE A PUBLIC COMPANY - THIS ROUND DE-RISKS

key_facts.fact: OpenAI expects to reach a 50-50 split between enterprise and consumer revenue by end of 2026
key_facts.excerpt: OPENAI CFO FRIAR: THINK BY THE END OF THIS YEAR WE'L BE 50-50 ENTERPRISE AND CONSUMER

stories.headline: Arm Unveils AGI CPU, Its First Data Center Chip, Co-Developed with Meta on TSMC 3nm

key_facts.fact: Arm announced the AGI CPU on March 24, its first production data center processor, manufactured on TSMC's 3-nanometer process
key_facts.excerpt: Arm Holdings announced a new artificial intelligence data center chip on Tuesday which it said will add billions of dollars of revenue and represent a significant shift in the company's strategy

key_facts.fact: Meta is the lead partner and will deploy the AGI CPU alongside its own custom chips in its data centers
key_facts.excerpt: Arm said it co-developed the AGI CPU with Meta, which is deploying them alongside its own custom chips inside its data centers

key_facts.fact: Arm claims the chip delivers 2x performance per rack compared to x86 platforms from Intel and AMD
key_facts.excerpt: Arm said its CPU delivers twice the performance per rack compared to those other platforms

key_facts.fact: The chip targets the growing demand for CPUs in agentic AI workloads, where inference is becoming more important than training
key_facts.excerpt: as the industry transitions toward agentic applications — AI that can perform tasks on your behalf — CPUs are becoming more important

key_facts.fact: Arm shares jumped 6.5% in extended trading; the company expects the chip to add billions in annual revenue
key_facts.excerpt: Arm shares jumped 6.5% in the extended session after the company issued its financial projections

key_facts.fact: The move represents a strategic shift for Arm, which has historically relied only on IP licensing and royalties rather than producing its own silicon
key_facts.excerpt: For years, Arm, majority-owned by Japan's SoftBank Group, has relied only on intellectual property for revenue, licensing its designs to companies such as Qualcomm and Nvidia

stories.headline: Databricks Launches Lakewatch Agentic SIEM Powered by Claude, Acquires Two Startups

key_facts.fact: Databricks launched Lakewatch, an agentic SIEM using AI agents powered by Anthropic's Claude for threat detection and response at petabyte scale
key_facts.excerpt: Lakewatch takes Databricks' ability to store massive amounts of data and performs classic Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tasks, like detecting and investigating threats. Only it does so with the help of AI agents powered by Anthropic's Claude.

key_facts.fact: Databricks acquired Antimatter (deal closed last year) and SiftD.ai (deal closed March 23) to underpin the product
key_facts.excerpt: Databricks bought two startups to underpin this new product: Antimatter, in an undisclosed-until-now deal that closed last year, and SiftD.ai, in a deal that flew together over the last couple of weeks and closed on Monday

key_facts.fact: SiftD.ai co-founder Steve Zhang was former chief scientist at Splunk who created the Search Processing Language
key_facts.excerpt: The Databricks team knew the startup's co-founder CEO Steve Zhang from his many years as chief scientist at Splunk (through 2021). He created the Search Processing Language while there.

key_facts.fact: CEO Ali Ghodsi declared 'This will be the year we see AI killing the SIEM' at RSAC conference in San Francisco
key_facts.excerpt: 'This will be the year we see AI killing the SIEM,' Databricks Chief Executive Ali Ghodsi said at a presentation today at the RSAC cybersecurity conference in San Francisco

key_facts.fact: Lakewatch claims up to 80% lower total cost of ownership vs traditional SIEM with no per-byte license fees
key_facts.excerpt: New product enables unlimited and unified data, petabyte-scale threat detection and investigations at up to 80% lower TCO

key_facts.fact: Databricks frames the product as deploying defensive AI agents to counter offensive AI agent attacks at machine speed
key_facts.excerpt: 'So now we can fight agents with agents,' which can do a first pass on hundreds of daily alerts that humans can't manage

stories.headline: Google DeepMind and Agile Robots Partner to Deploy Gemini Robotics in Factories

key_facts.fact: Agile Robots and Google DeepMind formed a strategic research partnership to integrate Gemini Robotics foundation models into industrial robots
key_facts.excerpt: The partnership involves Agile Robots implementing Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics foundation models into its bots and the data being collected by the robots used to improve the underlying Gemini AI models.

key_facts.fact: Agile Robots has deployed over 20,000 robotics solutions worldwide and employs more than 2,500 people
key_facts.excerpt: Agile Robots was founded in Munich in 2018 and now employs more than 2,500 people. The company says it has already deployed over 20,000 robotics solutions worldwide.

key_facts.fact: Target sectors include electronics manufacturing, automotive, data centers, and logistics
key_facts.excerpt: The companies will work together to test, fine-tune, and deploy robots that use Gemini foundation models in industrial use cases across sectors, including electronics manufacturing, automotive, data centers, and logistics.

key_facts.fact: Data collected from real-world robot deployments will feed back into improving the Gemini AI models, creating a continuous improvement loop
key_facts.excerpt: The plan is to use data from real-world operations to continuously improve the AI models, which in turn makes the robots more capable over time.

key_facts.fact: Agile Robots has raised more than $270 million in venture capital since its 2018 founding in Munich
key_facts.excerpt: Agile Robots was founded in 2018 and has raised more than $270 million in venture capital funding from investors

stories.headline: Amazon Acquires Fauna Robotics and Its $50K Sprout Humanoid for Consumer Market

key_facts.fact: Amazon acquired Fauna Robotics, whose Sprout humanoid is a $50,000, 3-foot-6-inch, 50-pound bipedal robot designed for homes and schools
key_facts.excerpt: Fauna's first product, called Sprout, is a $50,000 bipedal robot that's 3 feet, 6 inches tall and designed to be 'approachable and human-friendly.'

key_facts.fact: Fauna was founded in 2024 by former Meta and Google engineers; its approximately 50 employees will join Amazon in New York
key_facts.excerpt: Fauna Robotics was founded in 2024 by former Meta and Google engineers... Fauna's roughly 50 employees will join Amazon in New York

key_facts.fact: Disney and Hyundai's Boston Dynamics were among Sprout's early customers before the acquisition
key_facts.excerpt: The company said at the time that it signed up Disney and Hyundai's Boston Dynamics as early customers.

key_facts.fact: Amazon already operates more than 1 million robots across its warehouse operations
key_facts.excerpt: The e-commerce giant is already a robotics powerhouse, having boasted of deploying more than 1 million robots across its warehouse operations

key_facts.fact: Amazon also acquired Rivr last week for last-mile delivery automation, signaling a broader robotics acquisition push
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon last week acquired Rivr as it explores automating aspects of its last-mile delivery.

stories.headline: Highlight AI Raises $40M Series A from Khosla Ventures for AI Agent Operating System

key_facts.fact: Highlight AI raised $40 million in Series A funding led by Khosla Ventures for its 'intelligent operating system for teams and AI agents'
key_facts.excerpt: Highlight AI, an intelligent operating system for teams and AI agents, announced a $40 million Series A funding round led by Khosla Ventures.

key_facts.fact: Investors include 359 Capital, General Catalyst, Valor Equity, Common Metal, Makers Fund, Collaborative Fund, Arcadia, and SV Angel
key_facts.excerpt: The Series A funding round attracted the global investment community, including 359 Capital, General Catalyst, Valor Equity, Common Metal, Makers Fund, Collaborative Fund, Arcadia, and SV Angel.

key_facts.fact: Vinod Khosla stated the gap between AI capabilities and coordination systems exists 'across every industry and at every scale' and that an OS maintaining human-machine alignment 'becomes imperative'
key_facts.excerpt: Vinod Khosla, founder of Khosla Ventures, said: 'Software and AI have advanced faster than the systems that coordinate them. That gap exists across every industry and at every scale. As work becomes more agent-driven, an operating system that maintains alignment between humans and machines becomes imperative.'

sources.title: Highlight AI Raises $40 Million in Series A Funding
